Sea of Red: Caitlin Clark Debuts a Kansas City Chiefs Gradient Colorway of the Nike Caitlin 1

Zach Harris
Published September 21, 2026 at 12:30 PM
Add to Google News

Quick Facts

  • Featuring a yellow sole and a red Opticast upper, the shoe brings more yellow to the background of the colorway for a sunset-shaded gradient combo
  • The multi-Swoosh side panel branding mixes silver and black, with more silver on the tongue logo
  • The Nike Caitlin 1 Sea of Red isn’t on the Nike schedule yet

Caitlin Clark is riding high on Monday morning this week, not only because the Indiana Fever are guaranteed a WNBA playoff spot somewhere between the 2 and 8 seed with one week left of the regular season, but also because her Kansas City Chiefs squeeked out an overtime win against the her WNBA home’s local Colts. Like always, Clark was prepared for success, celebrating the Chiefs' 2-0 start with a new colorway of her Nike Caitlin 1.

A New Chief in Indy

The Nike Caitlin 1 Sea of Red is the latest from a long line of Nike Caitlin 1 colorways, including a signature collection that starts dropping next week, plus a handful of PEs that don’t have a release date yet. Joining her Taylor Swift friendship bracelet pair, the Sea of Red is another colorway that Mrs. Kelce might see in the luxury box at Arrowhead.

Featuring a yellow sole and a red Opticast upper, the shoe brings more yellow to the background of the colorway for a sunset-shaded gradient combo. The multi-Swoosh side panel branding mixes silver and black, with more silver on the tongue logo.

Is the Nike Caitlin 1 Sea of Red Dropping?

The Nike Caitlin 1 Sea of Red isn’t on the Nike schedule yet, but with football season just getting started, there’s always a chance the colorway gets a formal drop sometime in the future. To keep up with all the latest from Caitlin Clark and Nike, download the Sole Retriever App.
